title: eBird Checklist Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ebird:checklist
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by location_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when eBird checklist data has stopped arriving for a given location.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per location and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It lays out when one part of your eBird checklist feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
